name: tract_developer_lot_suitable_order
description: Test 24, by hand from 4.8. Part 1: residential developer with construction-info land value range [50, 100]; its only lot is in state 2 (Constructing) and the land value at its cell is 10: check 3 (land value, 22) runs before check 4 (state, 4), so IsLotSuitable gives 22. Grow: the lot is not eligible for takeover (1); the existing-lot listing gets 22, aggregation 5 (equal sizes), subdivision the cached 22: best 22, pushed in both passes (pass 2 ends the call): outcomes [22, 22]; row 0 {22: 2}; row 8 {22: 2} (computed once per pass, the cache is cleared at each pass). Part 2: land value range [0, 0] (not checked); a historical abandoned lot whose building matches the developer (purpose 1, wealth 1, configuration stage 1 < 3): IsLotSuitable(L, false) returns 18 (check 6f), which TakeOverAbandoned accepts; demand 1 gives T0 0, T1 = trunc(r24(1 x 1.2f)) = 1, sum 8 > 0: the lot is reoccupied (8 > 1 stops after it), Grow returns 8 with outcomes [27]; row 8 {18: 1}.
